original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯州安全信托基金与尼日利亚海关寻求加强安全合作
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 拉各斯州安全信托基金执行秘书兼首席执行官奥耶莱·奥贡桑呼吁各安全机构加强合作，以打击走私和跨国犯罪。尼日利亚海关总署A区联邦行动部门主管奥拉达波·阿费尼在拉各斯伊凯贾阿拉乌萨的基金办公室对其进行礼节性拜访时，奥贡桑作出上述表态。奥贡桑表示，该基金愿与海关在提供设备、后勤及其他机构支持方面探讨合作。

location.site: 伊凯贾阿拉乌萨的基金办公室
location.raw_text: the fund’s office in Alausa, Ikeja, Lagos

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州安全信托基金呼吁安全机构加强合作打击走私和跨国犯罪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Executive Secretary and Chief Executive Officer of the Lagos State Security Trust Fund, Dr Ayodele Ogunsan, has called for stronger collaboration among security agencies to tackle smuggling and transnational crimes.

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚海关总署A区联邦行动部门主管对基金进行礼节性拜访
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Comptroller of the Federal Operations Unit, Zone A, of the Nigeria Customs Service, Comptroller Oladapo Afeni, paid him a courtesy visit at the fund’s office in Alausa, Ikeja, Lagos.

key_facts.fact: 该基金表示愿在设备、后勤和机构支持方面与海关合作
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He expressed the readiness of the LSSTF to explore areas of cooperation with the Customs Service, particularly in providing equipment, logistics and other institutional support to strengthen security operations.

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道未说明具体合作计划或时间表
